Nederman is committed to providing our customers with leading engineering, design and turn-key air filtration solutions and services. We value employees who are highly motivated, well organized and have a desire to be part of a collaborative culture, and with a passion for handling challenging and diverse assignments. results.title: Director, People Operations
results.description: Brief Description The Director of People Operations will work from the company's headquarters in Harlem River Yard – NYC, reporting to the Head of People. The Director will have a vital role in the People Leadership Team, working towards transforming our workplace culture and emphasizing the growth and well-being of our employees, with a specific focus on hourly employees' environments. Responsibilities: Design and implement comprehensive people strategies that align with organizational goals and objectives in a transforming group that’s pioneering e-commerce and grocery delivery in the US, with a specific focus on union dynamics. Collaborate closely with the COO and Operations leadership to ensure People initiatives support overall business objectives. Oversee employee engagement, performance management and workforce planning to enhance organization effectiveness. Drive initiatives to foster a positive and inclusive workplace culture, focusing on employee satisfaction and retention, with an understanding of the complexities introduced by a unionized environment. Facilitate effective communication channels between management and employees, addressing concerns and promoting transparency, with a keen awareness of the communication dynamics in a unionized workforce. Establish and enforce policies and procedures that comply with state and federal requirements, including those specific to labor law and collective bargaining agreements. Analyze trends and metrics in partnership with the People team to develop relevant solutions, programs and policies. Identify training needs and individual performance and coaching needs. Participate in evaluation and monitoring of success of training programs. Follow-up to ensure training objectives are met. Lead a team of People Business Partners providing ongoing management, coaching and development. Education and Qualifications: Proven track record of strategic leadership in senior HR roles, preferably at the Sr HRBP or Director level. Extensive experience in developing and implementing people strategies, especially in unionized environments. Strong understanding of HR dynamics, including talent acquisition, employee engagement, and performance management. Demonstrated ability to foster a positive workplace culture and achieve employee satisfaction and retention goals in a unionized context. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to build and maintain effective relationships. Proven leadership experience with the ability to manage and develop a high-performing team. Strategic thinker with a results-oriented mindset. Who is FreshDirect: In 2023, FreshDirect officially become a part of the Getir family! This strategic partnership combines FreshDirect's diverse product portfolio and expansive customer base with Getir's renowned expertise in ultrafast grocery delivery and cutting-edge technology. Getir, well-known for its lightning-fast grocery delivery services, is set to enhance FreshDirect's infrastructure with its technological prowess. By leveraging Getir's rapid delivery approach, FreshDirect aims to redefine the future of grocery delivery in the United States. Why choose FreshDirect? We're a company that thrives on teamwork. Our evolution is driven by our passionate employees and investment in perfecting the technology that lets us deliver the highest-quality food. Our state-of-the-art facility creates an environment for innovation. We support our employees with on-the-job training for plant employees and drivers, team-building activities, workplace recognition opportunities, and by encouraging direct relationships with our suppliers in the field. Great people deserve great perks. We offer comprehensive benefits, plus many workplace extras, including: A flexible and generous paid time off plan 20% off at freshdirect.com and significant markdowns at our employee market 24-hour access to the FreshDirect shuttle between our Bronx headquarters and the subway Regular events and barbecues for employees Click to explore careers and life @ FreshDirect Learn more @FreshDirect on Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube! results.title: VP Human Resources-PST Segment
results.description: About Us Ingersoll Rand thrives on a culture of innovation and a sense of ownership, committed to enhancing the lives of our employees, customers, and the planet. With over 80 renowned brands, our customers rely on our products and services to deliver high-quality flow creation and industrial solutions designed to perform in the most complex and harsh conditions. Additionally, our unwavering commitment to ownership has enabled our employees to cultivate strong customer relationships, driving them to solve the industry’s most difficult problems. Job Summary Reporting directly to the CHRO and functionally to the SVP of Ingersoll Rand’s Precision & Science Technologies (PST) segment, the Vice President of Human Resources – PST Segment will spearhead and manage all HR aspects for an $1.3B global, rapidly growing business segment with 4,000+ associates. In this role, you will serve as a critical business partner and strategist on the leadership team for the PST segment, and on the Ingersoll Rand HR Leadership Team. You will closely partner with PST business leaders to continue the rapid growth (organically & inorganically), while ensuring continuous improvement in critical areas such as Engagement, Talent Development, Culture, Diversity-Equity-Inclusion, and Organizational Effectiveness. Additionally, you will oversee a team of HR professionals, as they deliver high-quality HR solutions for leaders, managers, and associates. Responsibilities Effectively partner with PST business leaders to drive positive, business-impacting change, aligning human resources programs and initiatives with strategic objectives and annual operating plans. Serve as a performance coach for PST business leaders to ensure the team is highly effective in improving organizational capability and is continuing to win in the marketplace. Drive HR aspects of Mergers & Acquisitions, including pipeline formation, due diligence, planning & execution, and effective integration of acquired companies. Supervise a team of HR professionals in delivering effective HR execution globally. Manage and develop capabilities of the HR team to support business initiatives and to ensure development of HR talent Collaborate with HR Leadership Team colleagues to set direction for the HR-Talent strategies for the company. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution is required. Master’s degree (MBA, Master’s in HR, etc.) is preferred, but not required. HR certifications are also a strong plus. Minimum of 10 years of increasing responsibility in a progressive HR environment. Minimum of 5 years leading experienced HR Leaders. Demonstrated expertise in building talent, engaging teams, driving culture change and strategic growth of businesses and organizations. Direct experience supporting multiple businesses in a global matrix environment. Direct experience leading HR teams in Europe. Demonstrated success in creating an environment of trust with business partners where integrity is unquestioned. Excellent interpersonal, influencing and communications skills. Knowledge of relevant local/state/federal/provincial employment laws. Must be authorized to work in the US without company sponsorship. Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements This will be a remotely based position with anticipated travel of up to 50%. Key Competencies Prior experience in an industrial company. Experience leading the HR aspects of Mergers & Acquisitions. Direct experience in manufacturing and commercial environments. What We Offer At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond.
